status: proposed illustrative policy, not an organisational standard or validated assay specification

context.disease_context: inflammatory skin disease-like assay; no patient-efficacy claim
context.cell_context: stimulated, Th17-enriched primary human CD4 T-cell culture (synthetic)
context.intervention: partial reduction of target expression; no claim of equivalence to activity blockade
context.endpoint: relative reduction in fraction of live CD4 T cells that are IL-17A positive

assay_descriptions.KD-B: CRISPRi expression reduction, corroborating method; same donors

prerequisite_rules.G0: Exact hypothesis, endpoint, context and policy version match.
prerequisite_rules.G1: Eight complete donor pairs per method, three technical wells averaged per condition, at least 5000 live CD4 events per well. No outcome-driven exclusions.
prerequisite_rules.G2: Each donor/method: NTC viable fraction >=90%; stimulated/unstimulated IL-17A-positive fraction ratio >=3; positive control functional reduction >=40%, viable fraction >=85%, live-cell recovery >=90%; maximum technical CV <=15%.
prerequisite_rules.G3: Each donor/method: target surface-protein MFI reduction within 40-70% inclusive.
prerequisite_rules.G4: Each donor/method: viable fraction >=85% and live-cell recovery >=85% of paired NTC. Each method: lower 95% CI for mean live-cell recovery >=90% of NTC.

action_rules.ADVANCE_TO_REPLICATION: G0-G4 pass; both methods lower 95% confidence bound >=20% functional reduction. New donors/batches plus target-specificity work; specialist feasibility discussion only.
action_rules.DEPRIORITIZE_TESTED_HYPOTHESIS: G0-G4 pass; both methods upper 95% confidence bound <20%. Applies to useful mean benefit at achieved expression reduction in this assay/context only.
action_rules.INCONCLUSIVE: Any prerequisite fails, a useful-effect boundary is crossed, or methods disagree. No automatic advance or target-wide rejection.

analysis: For each donor: d = 100*(1 - KD_IL17_positive_fraction / matched_NTC_fraction). Equal-weight donor mean +/- t(0.975,7)*sample_SD/sqrt(8). Technical wells and individual cells do not increase n. Analyze methods separately; do not pool correlated methods.
rounding: Display one decimal place; apply criteria to unrounded computed values, allowing only 1e-9 absolute units for floating-point noise.
limitations: Eight donors is a demo size, not a powered sample-size recommendation.
Confidence intervals assume appropriate independent donor sampling and approximate normality of donor effects; synthetic data validate arithmetic only.
These are per-method intervals, not a jointly calibrated target-success probability or a multiplicity-adjusted discovery claim.
Twenty percent is a provisional useful-effect threshold, not literature-derived or clinically validated.
Expression reduction in two methods does not establish equivalence to inhibition, antagonism or degradation.
A viability pass does not establish tissue or systemic safety.
